app.title: QosID Flow
auth.passwordTooShort: The password must be at least 8 characters
auth.passwordChanged: Password changed — sign in again with the new password
auth.passwordChangeRequired: The default password (admin/admin) is still in use — no other page works until you change it
auth.allDown: Could not reach the servers — neither the gateway nor the ops sidecar is responding
auth.gatewayDown: The gateway is stopped — only the Ops page is available
auth.gatewaySessionExpired: The gateway session has expired — sign in again
settings.title: Settings
settings.stopToEdit: Stop the service from the Ops page to edit these settings
settings.appliesOnStart: Changes are made while the service is stopped and take effect on the next start

settings.serviceRunning: The service is running — stop it from the Ops page before saving
settings.testNeedsService: The service must be running to test
errors.loadFailed: Could not load the logs — refresh to try again
stats.loadFailed: Could not load the metrics — refresh to try again
ai.title: AI analysis

ai.notConfigured: AI is not configured — set the base URL, API key and model to enable it
telegram.hint: DLQ alerts are sent through this bot. With no value stored in the DB, the env vars (TELEGRAM_*) apply.
common.secretPlaceholder: (leave empty to keep the current value)

ops.confirmStopBody: Requests that arrive while it is stopped wait in the Kafka queue and are processed once the gateway starts again.
ops.actionFailed: The action did not complete — check the ops log
ops.sessionExpired: The ops session has expired — sign in again
ops.logEmpty: No log lines yet — output appears here as the gateway writes it
ops.unavailable: No connection to ops, or the session has expired
ops.reloginHint: Sign in again to restore ops control
auth.footNote: Every request — tracked, retried, never lost
